migration_setup.relationship_notes: Account links to Client and may link to Household; Household groups related Clients and/or Accounts. Confirm these relationships with the data owner.

source_files.context: Legacy account master extract; contains account identity and registration details.
source_files.dictionary_notes: LEGACY_ACCT_NO is the source account identifier. LEGACY_CLIENT_ID links to the client file. HOUSEHOLD_LINK_ID is a candidate household relationship.
HOUSEHOLD_ID identifies the household grouping. PRIMARY_CLIENT_ID is a candidate link to the client file.
CLIENT_ID identifies a person or legal party. LEGAL_NAME and CLIENT_TYPE describe the party.

source_files.context: Account registration and custodian detail extract.
source_files.dictionary_notes: Legacy account number identifies the account; registration type and open date describe the account.
Account number identifies the account; legacy client and household link identifiers are candidate relationships.
Household ID and name identify the household; primary client ID is a candidate relationship.
Household ID identifies the group; account number identifies an associated account.
Client ID and legal name identify the client; email and contact status are contact attributes.
Party source ID and party name identify the client; tax identifier is a sensitive attribute and the demo value is synthetic.
